en: Abstract In our neo-transcendental approach, physical theories are built up from a categorial structure that is mathematically interpreted (what Kant called the “mathematical construction of categories”). The interpretation of physical categories provided by noncommutative geometry is presented in this perspective.
zh: 摘要 在我们的新先验进路中，物理理论建立在经过数学解释的范畴结构之上（即康德所谓“范畴的数学构造”）。本文在这一视角下呈现非交换几何对物理范畴的解释。

en: In the early 1980s I began a research program which developed a new transcendental epistemology for modern theoretical physics. A synthetic summary of this approach can be found (in French) in my book La Philosophie transcendantale et le probl`eme de l’Objectivit´e (1991) and (in English) in my paper “Actuality of Transcendental Aesthetics for Modern Physics” (1992) for the international Conference 1830–1930: Un si`ecle de g´eom´etrie, de C.F. Gauss et B. Riemann `a H. Poincar´e et E. Cartan : ´epist´emologie, histoire, et math´ematiques held at the Institut Henri Poincar´e in Paris the 18–23 September 1989. Further developements can be found in other papers cited in the bibliography.
zh: 20 世纪 80 年代初，我启动了一项研究计划，为现代理论物理学发展了一种新的先验认识论。这一进路的综合概述可见于我的法文著作《先验哲学与客观性问题》（La Philosophie transcendantale et le problème de l’Objectivité，1991），以及我为 1989 年 9 月 18–23 日在巴黎彭加勒研究所（Institut Henri Poincaré）举行的国际会议“1830–1930：从高斯与黎曼到彭加勒与嘉当，几何学的一百年：认识论、历史与数学”（1830–1930: Un siècle de géométrie, de C.F. Gauss et B. Riemann à H. Poincaré et E. Cartan : épistémologie, histoire, et mathématiques）撰写的英文论文《先验感性论对现代物理学的现实意义》（“Actuality of Transcendental Aesthetics for Modern Physics”，1992）。进一步的发展可见于书目中引用的其他论文。

en: The key idea is that, if physical theories are conceptually construed on the basis of categorial concepts such as “system”, “state”, “observable”, etc. and geometrodynamical intuitions such as those of space, time or motion, these representations have to be mathematically interpreted in a specific way (what Kant called the “mathematical construction of categories”) in order to constitute a well-behaved physical objectivity. In this way, physical objectivity cannot be an ontology, and the departure of objectivity from ontology is, I think, the basic justification for transcendentalism.
zh: 关键的想法是：如果物理理论是在“系统”、“状态”、“可观测量”等范畴概念以及空间、时间、运动等几何动力学直观的基础上概念地构造起来的，那么这些表象就必须以特定的方式得到数学解释（即康德所谓“范畴的数学构造”），才能构成一种运作良好的物理客观性。这样一来，物理客观性就不可能是一种本体论，而客观性与本体论的分离，我认为是先验论的基本理据。

en: Even if objective categories remain fairly invariant in the history of physics, their mathematical interpretation has changed tremendously as physical theories have evolved, but this is by no means an argument against transcendentalism. On the contrary, the by now classical criticisms of Reichenbach, Carnap and many others are perhaps valid against a rigid, narrow minded, dogmatic reading of Kant but certainly not against a more general and open conception of transcendentalism. Incidentally, logical positivism is in great part a “grammatical” reinterpretation of classical transcendentalism.
zh: 尽管客观范畴在物理学史中保持相当程度的不变，它们的数学解释却随着物理理论的演化发生了巨大变化，但这绝不是反对先验论的论据。相反，赖欣巴赫、卡尔纳普以及许多其他人如今已成经典的批评，用来反驳僵化、狭隘而教条的康德解读也许成立，却不足以否定更一般、更开放的先验论。顺带一提，逻辑实证主义在很大程度上是对经典先验论的一种“语法”重释。

en: In fact, Kant was the first philosopher to discover the constitutive nature of objectivity – “discovery of the constitutive element” that Hans Reichenbach himself called an “eminent philosophical result”: objective principles are prescriptive rather than descriptive, and they are constitutive of physical reality. But in Kant, the constitutive components of objectivity were rooted in a cognitive representational theory. As Schlick pointed out, they were characteristic of our representational consciousness. That is why a form of transcendental subjectivism became the foundational basis for objectivity. Developments in physics (General Relativity and Quantum Mechanics) created a conflict between the objective components and their cognitive basis. However the appropriate response to this situation is not provided by logical positivism, but rather by a renewed transcendentalism where the objective and the cognitive components are methodologically separated. This transcendentalism is no longer founded on cognitive universals but on procedures of mathematical “construction”.
zh: 事实上，康德是第一位发现客观性之构成性本性的哲学家——汉斯·赖欣巴赫本人称之为“杰出哲学成果”的“构成性要素的发现”：客观原理是规定性的而非描述性的，它们构成物理实在。但在康德那里，客观性的构成成分植根于一种认知表象理论。正如石里克所指出的，它们是我们的表象意识的特征。这就是为什么一种先验主观主义成为客观性的奠基基础。物理学的发展（广义相对论与量子力学）在客观成分与其认知基础之间制造了冲突。然而，对这一局面的恰当回应不是由逻辑实证主义提供的，而是由一种更新了的先验论提供的，在其中客观成分与认知成分在方法论上被分离。这种先验论不再奠基于认知的普遍结构，而是奠基于数学“构造”的程序。

en: In the previously cited papers I have shown how Hamiltonian (symplectic) mechanics, general relativity, non abelian gauge theories, and even superstring theories can be transcendentally interpreted in a very natural way. I aim at presenting in this perspective the deep and technical mathematical interpretation of physical categories provided by noncommutative geometry.
zh: 在前面引用的论文中，我已经展示了哈密顿（辛）力学、广义相对论、非阿贝尔规范理论乃至超弦理论如何能够以非常自然的方式得到先验解释。我旨在从这一视角呈现非交换几何对物理范畴所作的深刻而技术性的数学解释。
2 先验论的推广与“历史化”

en: As we have seen in the Introduction of this volume, a generalized and “historicized” transcendental perspective on modern physics can be based on very general principles:
zh: 正如我们在本书导论中所见，关于现代物理学的一种推广的、“历史化”的先验视角可以建立在非常一般的原理之上：

en:
1. Physics deals only with phenomena. Phenomena are relational entities that are inseparable from their conditions of observation: access conditions (observation, measurement, gathering of information, etc.) are constitutive of the very concept of physical object. In that sense, physical objectivity cannot be the ontology of a mind-independent substantial reality and any ontological realism has to be rejected.
2. But even if they lose ontological content, “categorial” concepts still have a theoretical function. In order to be transformed into scientific objects, phenomena must be conceptually lawful, “legalized” according to a categorial structure. The first philosophical thematization of this principle was Kant’s Metaphysische Anfangsgründe der Naturwissenschaft (MAN). Kant explained how the four groups of categories and principles specialize in physics into Phoronomy (Kinematics), Dynamics, Mechanics, and Phenomenology, and how they are mathematically interpreted in Newtonian Mechanics.
3. The essential feature of physics is the mathematical interpretation which transforms the categorial concepts into algorithms for the mathematical reconstruction of phenomena. This is a critical point. Physics has to solve an inverse problem, namely the inverse problem of the abstraction problem. Conceptual analysis must be supplemented by a computational synthesis of phenomena. In Kant, computational synthesis is first based on schematization and then on the “construction” of categories.
zh:
1. 物理学只处理现象。现象是关系性实体，与其观察条件不可分离：通达条件（观察、测量、信息收集等）构成物理对象概念本身。在这个意义上，物理客观性不可能是独立于心灵的实体性实在的本体论，任何本体论实在论都必须被拒斥。
2. 但即使失去了本体论内容，“范畴”概念仍然具有理论功能。为了被转化为科学对象，现象必须在概念上合乎法则，按照一个范畴结构被“合法化”。康德在哲学上首次集中阐述这一原理，见他的《自然科学的形而上学初始根据》（MAN）。康德解释了四组范畴与原理如何在物理学中特化为运动学（Phoronomy）、动力学、力学与现象学，以及它们如何在牛顿力学中得到数学解释。
3. 物理学的本质特征是数学解释，它把范畴概念转化为对现象进行数学重构的算法。这是一个关键点。物理学必须求解一个反问题，即抽象问题的反问题。概念分析必须由现象的计算综合来补充。在康德那里，计算综合首先基于图型化，然后基于范畴的“构造”。

en: The main difficulty with a generalized transcendentalism is to understand the general meaning of Transcendental Aesthetics. The latter presents two aspects corresponding to what Kant called two “expositions” (Erörterung = “clear representation of what belongs to a concept”) in the Kritik der reinen Vernunft (KRV): the metaphysical and the transcendental. First, phenomena are observable and therefore must appear to an observer. They appear in a specific medium of manifestation (space and time for sensible phenomena) which provides “forms of intuition”. Second, these “forms” can be mathematically determined and converted into what Kant called “formal intuitions” (see the celebrated footnote to section 26 of KRV). To determine phenomena objectively, we need therefore a link between mathematically determined forms of observability (what is “gegeben”) and categorial forms of lawfulness (what is “gedacht”). In Kant this link is worked out at two levels. At the level of KRV it is provided by transcendental schematism which converts the categories into principles (“Grundsätze”). At the level of MAN, it is provided by what Kant called the construction (“Konstruktion”) of categories. The construction is a mode of presentation (“Darstellung”). It means that it is possible to interpret mathematically the schematized categorial contents by using mathematics stemming from the transcendental exposition of Transcendental Aesthetics. I think that it is in this very special sort of “mathematical hermeneutics” – not only for the intuitive forms of manifestation but also for the categorial forms of lawfulness themselves – that the synthetic a priori finds its true and deep transcendental meaning.
zh: 推广的先验论的主要困难在于理解先验感性论的一般意义。后者呈现两个方面，对应于康德在《纯粹理性批判》（KRV）中所谓的两种“阐明”（Erörterung = “对属于一个概念的东西的清晰表象”）：形而上学的阐明与先验的阐明。首先，现象是可观察的，因此必须向一个观察者显现。它们在特定的显现媒介中显现（对感性现象而言是空间与时间），该媒介提供“直观形式”。其次，这些“形式”可以被数学地规定，并转化为康德所谓的“形式直观”（见 KRV 第 26 节著名的脚注）。因此，要客观地规定现象，我们需要在数学地规定的可观察性形式（“被给予的”，gegeben）与合规律性的范畴形式（“被思维的”，gedacht）之间建立联系。在康德那里，这一联系在两个层次上展开。在 KRV 的层次上，它由先验图型法提供，后者把范畴转化为原理（“Grundsätze”）。在 MAN 的层次上，它由康德所谓的范畴的构造（“Konstruktion”）提供。构造是一种展示（“Darstellung”）方式。它意味着，可以利用源自先验感性论之先验阐明的数学，对图型化了的范畴内容进行数学解释。我认为，正是在这种非常特殊的“数学解释学”中——不仅针对显现的直观形式，也针对合规律性的范畴形式本身——综合先天才获得其真正而深刻的先验意义。

en: In the Introduction of the volume, we also reminded (in modern terms) the categorial moments of classical Mechanics according to the Metaphysische Anfangsgründe der Naturwissenschaft.
zh: 在本书导论中，我们还（用现代术语）回顾了按照《自然科学的形而上学初始根据》的经典力学的诸范畴环节。

en:
1. Phoronomy (Kinematics). “Mathematical” categories of quantity and “Axioms of Intuition” (“Axiomen der Anschauung”) governing “extensive” magnitudes: the Euclidean metric of space is a background (a priori) geometrical structure and physical motion complies with Galilean relativity.
2. Dynamics. “Mathematical” categories of quality and “Anticipations of Perception” (“Anticipationen der Wahrnehmung”) governing “intensive” magnitudes: physical dynamics has to be described in terms of differential entities (velocities, accelerations, etc.) varying covariantly (link with Phoronomy). Physics must therefore be a kind of differential geometry (not a “logic” in the traditional Aristotelian sense).
zh:
1. 运动学（Phoronomy）。量的“数学”范畴与支配“外延”量的“直观公理”（“Axiomen der Anschauung”）：空间的欧几里得度规是一个背景（先天）几何结构，物理运动遵从伽利略相对性。
2. 动力学。质的“数学”范畴与支配“内涵”量的“知觉的预测”（“Anticipationen der Wahrnehmung”）：物理动力学必须用协变地变化的微分实体（速度、加速度等）来描述（与运动学的联系）。因此物理学必须是一种微分几何（而不是传统亚里士多德意义上的“逻辑”）。

en:
3. Mechanics. “Dynamical”, i.e. physical, categories of relation (substance = Inhärenz und Subsistenz, causality = Causalität und Dependenz, community, reciprocity and interaction = Gemeinschaft) and “Analogies of Experience” (“Analogien der Erfahrung”): the category of substance is reinterpreted as the transcendental principle of conservation laws, the category of causality as that of forces, and the category of community as that of interactions.
4. Phenomenology. Categories of modality and “Postulates of empirical thought” (“Postulate des empirischen Denkens überhaupt”): because of relativity, motion cannot be a real but only a “possible” predicate of matter (it is a purely relational phenomenon). Position and velocity are not observable properties whose values could individuate dynamical states. The sentence “The body S “has” such position and such velocity” (in the sense of “having a property”) is not a physical judgment. We find here the root of the transcendental ideality of space and time, which has nothing to do with a subjective idealism à la Berkeley. But forces (causality) are real and are governed by necessary laws. Necessity is not a logical but a transcendental modality. It is conditional, relative to the radical contingency of possible experience.
zh:
3. 力学。关系的“动力学”范畴，即物理范畴（实体＝依存与自存，Inhärenz und Subsistenz；因果性＝因果与依赖，Causalität und Dependenz；共同体、相互性与交互作用＝Gemeinschaft）与“经验的类比”（“Analogien der Erfahrung”）：实体范畴被重释为守恒律的先验原理，因果性范畴被重释为力的原理，共同体范畴被重释为相互作用的原理。
4. 现象学。模态范畴与“一般经验思维的公设”（“Postulate des empirischen Denkens überhaupt”）：由于相对性，运动不可能是物质的实在谓词，而只能是“可能的”谓词（它是纯粹关系性的现象）。位置与速度不是其值能够个体化动力学状态的可观察属性。“物体 S ‘具有’某位置与某速度”这个句子（在“具有一个属性”的意义上）不是一个物理判断。我们在这里找到了空间与时间的先验观念性的根源，它与贝克莱式的主观观念论毫无关系。但力（因果性）是实在的，并受必然规律支配。必然性不是逻辑的模态，而是先验的模态。它是有条件的，相对于可能经验的根本偶然性。

en: A striking modern example of such a transcendental structure is provided by the constitutive role of symmetries. In general relativity and non abelian gauge theories, the radical enlargment of the symmetry groups enables us to construct mathematically on the basis of relativity principles not only the physical content of the categories of substance, but also the physical content of the categories of force and interaction. As far as I am concerned (a view shared by Daniel Bennequin, a specialist of symplectic geometry and string theory) this is a far-reaching manifestation of the “Galoisian” essence of modern physics: symmetries that express entities which cannot be physical observables act as principles of determination for the physical obervables themselves.
zh: 这种先验结构的一个引人注目的现代例子由对称性的构成性作用提供。在广义相对论与非阿贝尔规范理论中，对称群的根本扩大使我们能够在相对性原理的基础上，不仅数学地构造实体范畴的物理内容，而且构造力与相互作用范畴的物理内容。就我而言（这一观点也为辛几何与弦论专家达尼埃尔·贝纳坎所分享），这是现代物理学“伽罗瓦式”本质的一个深远表现：表达那些不可能成为物理可观测量的实体的对称性，充当物理可观测量本身的规定原理。

en: The evolution of modern physics displays fairly stable categorial structures, together with many changes in their successive mathematical interpretations. I think that such a variability is by no means an argument against a transcendental approach. For instance, according to Kant, the a priori nature of space and time means essentially that the Euclidean metric of space–time and the Galilean group act as a background structure for Mechanics. This remains perfectly true. In GR, the metric is no longer a background structure and becomes a dynamical feature of the theory. The Diff(M)-invariance implies that localization becomes relational so that points lack any physical content. But this background independence is no refutation of transcendentalism. I have developped the thesis that the differentiable structure of space–time and the associated cohomology of differential forms remain a background structure in GR.
zh: 现代物理学的演化显示出相当稳定的范畴结构，同时其相继的数学解释有许多变化。我认为这种可变性绝不是反对先验进路的论据。例如，按照康德，空间与时间的先天性本质上意味着时空的欧几里得度规与伽利略群充当力学的背景结构。这一点仍然完全正确。在广义相对论中，度规不再是背景结构，而成为理论的一个动力学特征。Diff(M) 不变性意味着位置的确定取决于相互关系，以至于点缺乏任何物理内容。但这种背景无关性并不是对先验论的反驳。我发展过这样一个论点：时空的可微结构及其相伴的微分形式上同调在广义相对论中仍然是背景结构。

en: In Petitot (1992a) I gave a transcendental approach to:
zh: 在 Petitot (1992a) 中，我给出了对以下内容的先验进路：

en: 1. Hamiltonian (symplectic) mechanics, in particular Noether’s theorem and the formalism of the momentum map worked out by B. Kostant, J.M. Souriau, V. Arnold, A. Weinstein, R. Abraham, and J. Marsden (deep broadening of the construction of the category of substance).
zh: 1. 哈密顿（辛）力学，特别是诺特定理以及由科斯坦特、苏里奥、阿诺尔德、温斯坦、亚伯拉罕与马斯登发展的动量映射形式体系（实体范畴构造的深刻拓展）。

en:
2. General relativity and the a priori determination of Einstein equations proposed by Wheeler, Misner, and Thorne in their Geometrodynamics (construction of the category of force).
3. Non abelian gauge theories (construction of the category of interaction).
zh:
2. 广义相对论以及惠勒、米斯纳与索恩在其《几何动力学》（Geometrodynamics）中提出的爱因斯坦方程的先天规定（力范畴的构造）。
3. 非阿贝尔规范理论（相互作用范畴的构造）。

en: As it turns out, this perspective shares many theses with Friedman’s works (Dynamics of Reason, 1999):

en: Let me now comment on a new technical example of mathematical reinterpretation of the categorial structures of physics. This reinterpretation is achieved by using John Baez’ requisite of background independence (less radical than Lee Smolin’s). The problem is rather difficult, especially in Quantum Gravity. In GR general covariance implies that the metric is no longer a background structure and points of space–time M lose any physical meaning: GR observables must be Diff(M) invariant and are therefore non-local. On the contrary (Carlip, 2001), in Quantum Field Theory there exists a fixed background space–time M and points have a physical meaning: the value ϕ(x) of a field ϕ at a point x ∈M is in principle obervable. How are we to eliminate the background geometry in QFT while maintaining at the same time the computational efficiency of geometry? How are we to reconcile mathematically theories such as GR and QFT which are so heterogeneous to one another? Remarkable suggestions exist – in particular loop quantum gravity developped by Abhay Ashtekar, Lee Smolin, Carlo Rovelli, John Baez, etc. – for enlarging the formal framework of Riemann and Cartan geometry and quantize some of their components, but it seems that the problem is not a technical problem to be reckoned with only at the boundary of physical theories but a basic foundational difficulty. This means that we need a change of paradigm, much like GR in the case of Riemannian geometry.
zh: 现在让我评论一个对物理学范畴结构进行数学重释的新技术例子。这一重释是通过运用约翰·贝兹的背景无关性要求（比李·斯莫林的更温和）来实现的。这个问题相当困难，尤其是在量子引力中。在广义相对论中，广义协变性意味着度规不再是背景结构，时空 M 的点失去任何物理意义：广义相对论的可观测量必须是 Diff(M) 不变的，因此是非定域的。相反（Carlip, 2001），在量子场论中存在一个固定的背景时空 M，点具有物理意义：场 ϕ 在点 x ∈M 处的值 ϕ(x) 原则上是可观察的。我们如何在量子场论中消除背景几何，同时保持几何的计算效力？我们如何在数学上调和广义相对论与量子场论这样差异如此之大的理论？已经存在一些出色的建议——特别是由阿贝·阿什特卡、李·斯莫林、卡洛·罗韦利、约翰·贝兹等人发展的圈量子引力——用于扩大黎曼与嘉当几何的形式框架并量子化其某些成分，但这个问题似乎不是一个只在物理理论边界处才需应付的技术问题，而是一个基本的奠基性困难。这意味着我们需要一次范式转变，就像广义相对论之于黎曼几何的情形那样。

en: We think that Gelfand theorem has a deep philosophical meaning. In classical mechanics “phoronomy” (kinematics) concerns the structure of the configuration space N and the phase space M := T ∗N. Observables and measurements are defined in terms of functions on these basic spaces directly construed from the geometry of space–time (transcendental aesthetics). Gelfand theorem shows than we can exchange the primary geometrical background and the secondary algebraic moment of measure, take measure as a primitive fact and reconstruct the geometric background from it as a secondary moment. In one word, we can substitute a “functional” transcendental aesthetics to a purely geometrical one.
zh: 我们认为盖尔范德定理具有深刻的哲学意义。在经典力学中，“运动学”（phoronomy）关注位形空间 N 与相空间 M := T ∗N 的结构。可观测量与测量用这些基本空间上的函数来定义，而这些空间直接从时空几何（先验感性论）构造而来。盖尔范德定理表明，我们可以交换原初的几何背景与次级的代数测量环节，把测量作为原初事实，并从中把几何背景重构为次级环节。一言以蔽之，我们可以用一种“泛函的”先验感性论取代纯几何的先验感性论。

en: In Quantum Mechanics, the basic structure is that of the noncommutative C∗- algebras A of observables. In Petitot (1992a) I suggested that “phoronomy” operates at this level. It is challenging and natural to wonder if there could exist a geometric correlate of this noncommutative algebraic setting. The deepest answer is Connes’ Noncommutative Geometry (NCG) also called Spectral Geometry or Quantum Geometry. In NCG the basic structure is the NC C∗-algebra A of obervables: any phenomenon is primarily something which is observable in the quantum sense, and not an event in space–time. But observables must be defined for states and are therefore represented in the space of states of the system, which is an Hilbert space and not the classical space. The associated NC space is then the space of irreducible representations.
zh: 在量子力学中，基本结构是可观测量构成的非交换 C∗ 代数 A。在 Petitot (1992a) 中我提出，“运动学”在这一层次上运作。一个富有挑战性而又自然的问题是：这种非交换代数设定是否存在几何对应物？最深刻的回答是孔涅的非交换几何（NCG），也称为谱几何或量子几何。在非交换几何中，基本结构是可观测量构成的非交换 C∗ 代数 A：任何现象首先是在量子意义上可观察的东西，而不是时空中的事件。但可观测量必须对状态来定义，因此被表示在系统的状态空间中，该空间是希尔伯特空间而不是经典空间。相伴的非交换空间于是是不可约表示的空间。

en: NCG is a fundamentally new step toward a geometrization of physics. The basic concepts (with their categorial content) remain almost the same but their mathematical interpretation is significantly complexified, since their classical meaning becomes a commutative limit. zh: 非交换几何是迈向物理学几何化的根本性新步骤。它不是从经典微分几何出发并试图在这一背景上发展量子力学，而是从量子力学出发构造一个新的量子几何框架。在这个意义上，孔涅是量子力学的爱因斯坦。他的研究计划最引人入胜的方面在于，他如何成功地在作用于希尔伯特空间的非交换 C∗ 代数框架内部重释经典几何的一切基本结构。基本概念（连同其范畴内容）几乎保持不变，但其数学解释被显著复杂化，因为其经典意义成为一个交换极限。我们在这里遇到了通过数学扩大而使物理理论发生概念转变的一个新的极深刻例子，正如广义相对论或量子力学中的情形。正如达尼埃尔·卡斯特勒 [NCG] 所解释的：
